title: Scalar and annihilator compatibility of vector integration before adjunction
statement: Let A,B be finite commutative rings, φ:A→B unital, and N,M positive annihilators of A,B with M dividing N. Let S be Noetherian with N and M invertible and E locally free of constant rank d. For a root-power, generator and derived-single normalized CoefficientLineComparison t [def-pur-finite-smooth-coefficient-arrows], the compact-support scalar map [lem-pur-etale-compact-scalar-coherence] followed by compact support of inverse scalar/pullback and pullback of (t.tensorPower d).hom, then vectorBundleIntegration at M, equals scalar extension of vectorBundleIntegration at N followed by ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso. The compactification, coefficients and integrations are those of [thm-amb-vector-bundle-purity, def-amb-vector-integration]. This is a trace equation before exceptional adjunction or zero-section pullback.

source.place: Paragraph 2, coefficient compatibility of vector integration; reduction compatibilities (3), Orientation.

proof.text: Apply finiteCoefficientTensor_factor to the canonical generator-normalized exponent-change root map and line isomorphism at B supplied by etaleFiniteTwistPullback. N annihilates B by applying φ to its vanishing in A. This factors t.tensorPower into the scalar tensor map at N followed by the fixed-ring exponent-change tensor.

Map this factorization through inverse image and compact support. The general-ring integration exponent theorem cancels its last factor against integration at M, giving integration at N over B. VectorTraceScalarDescent gives the remaining common-exponent scalar equation. The single/unit iso has identity inverse (and hence identity hom), so its transported scalar unit equals ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso.hom. CompactScalarChosenMap unfolds to the same canonical bundle compactification scalar map. All steps apply at rank zero, on an empty scheme, and for zero coefficient rings, and require no flatness of B over A.

theorem finiteVectorIntegration_scalar
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (N M : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hM : 0 < M) (hMN : M ∣ N)
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (hB : (M : B) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S]
    (d : ℕ) (E : S.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (hS' : IsUnit (M : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (t : CoefficientLineComparison φ N M hA hB S) :
    (compactScalarMap φ (vectorBundlePurityCompactification S d E)).app
        (vectorIntegrationCoefficient A N hA S d E) ≫
      (vectorBundlePurityLower B S d E).map
        ((scalarPullbackIso φ (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d E)).inv.app
            (line A N hA S d) ≫
          (ordinaryFinitePullback B (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d E)).map
            (t.tensorPower d).hom) ≫
      vectorBundleIntegration M hM B hB S hS' d E =
    (ordinaryScalar φ S).map (vectorBundleIntegration N hN A hA S hS d E) ≫
      (ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso φ S).hom
